stops.name: Parco della Murgia Materana
stops.detail: The natural archaeological park of the Rocky Churches of Materano, also called the park of the Materana Murgia, is a protected natural area of the Basilicata established by Regional Law no. 11 of 3 April 1990. Since [dated source] the definition "Sassi di Matera" in the list of UNESCO World Heritage Sites has been expanded including "The Sassi and the Park of the Rocky Churches of Matera".
